sdk.name: any model SDK the finder knows

preconditions.statement: A person who can open the provider's billing console is available; the agent never holds those credentials.
preconditions.evidencePrompt: Which role? A role, never a name or a login.

fixtures.plants: A project naming one provider in its manifest and another only in an import.
An environment file holding a placeholder beside the SDKs; the output must not contain it.
The same project; the output must locate the import and mark every limit NOT RECORDED, printing no amount.
A file that only mentions an import inside a string literal; the finder must name no provider. Found by running the finder on its own repository the day it shipped.
A project calling no model SDK; the recipe must say so and hand back no evidence line.

refusalTest.refusedLooksLike: the finder names what it found and marks every limit NOT RECORDED; it prints no amount and no environment value, and hands back no evidence line when it found nothing

exposure.covered: the model providers this repository's manifests and imports name
exposure.notCovered: providers called through a gateway, a proxy or a bare URL; other API keys; other applications on the same provider account; whatever the provider's limit excludes; a dynamic import; an import written at the start of a line inside a multi-line template literal, which still reads as a statement
exposure.behind: nothing — this recipe is the thing that stands behind every other cost recipe

evidenceLine.template: billing-alert-set — evidence: provider hard limit configured at <location>, read <date>

steps: Nothing in the repository to revert: the recipe wrote no file. The limit is removed in the provider console by the person who set it.

postconditions.buildNotWorse: run the project's own check before and after; restore every written file and refuse if it was clean and is not
postconditions.refusalLeavesNoTrace: a recipe that cannot finish writes nothing at all
